label: 📦 Extract from JSON
description: Pull a value out of a JSON column at the given path. e.g. '$.user.email' from {"user": {"email": "alice@example.com"}}.

path.label: JSON path
path.help: JSONPath syntax. Examples: $.field, $.user.email, $.items[0].name. Use $ to refer to the root.

asText.label: Force text output
asText.help: Off (default): preserves the JSON type — numbers become numbers, booleans become booleans. On: always returns the value as a string (useful when the field's type is inconsistent across rows).
